dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Kan du fortelle meg om din erfaring innen salgsbransjen?
dialogue.translation: Can you tell me about your experience in the sales industry?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Ja, jeg har jobbet i salgsbransjen i tre år og har lært mye gjennom den tiden.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I have worked in the sales industry for three years and have learned a lot through that time.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Hva synes du er de største fordelerne ved å jobbe her?
dialogue.translation: What do you think are the biggest advantages of working here?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Jeg synes teamet er veldig ansvarlig og at det er en god balanse mellom utfordring og støtte.
dialogue.translation: I think the team is very responsible and that there is a good balance between challenge and support.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Hvordan har du forberedt deg til dette møtet?
dialogue.translation: How have you prepared for this meeting?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Jeg har lest om selskapet og forstått dets mål klart, samt øvd på vanlige intervjuspørsmål.
dialogue.translation: I have read about the company and understood its goals clearly, and practiced common interview questions.

key_phrases.phrase: Jeg har jobbet i salgsbransjen i tre år
key_phrases.translation: I have worked in the sales industry for three years

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of Norwegian

vocabulary.note: Regular verb meaning to consume food.
General term for any type of food.
Describes something positive or tasty.
Used to introduce a contrast.
Adds information to what has already been said.
Refers to animal flesh as food.
Past tense of 'få' (to get or receive).
Describes something unique or particular.
Indicates location or time.
Refers to every individual in a group.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hva synes du om maten i dag? Jeg synes den er god.
dialogue.translation: What do you think about the food today? I think it’s good.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, men jeg fikk litt for mye kjøtt på tallerkenen min.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but I got a bit too much meat on my plate.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Forståelig. Jeg spiser også mer grønnsaker på siste tid.
dialogue.translation: Understandable. I also eat more vegetables lately.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Det er bra! Er det noe særlig du liker å spise?
dialogue.translation: That’s good! Is there anything special you like to eat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ja, jeg elsker fisk, spesielt på fredager.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I love fish, especially on Fridays.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hver fredag? Det er en fin tradisjon!
dialogue.translation: Every Friday? That’s a nice tradition!

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of Norwegian

vocabulary.note: Used to describe an event or situation occurring.
Refers to a portion or component of something.
Indicates a starting point in time.
To make something different.
Used to connect words or clauses.
General action verb.
Used to indicate manner or similarity.
Auxiliary verb indicating state or existence.
Refers to something different.
Indicates opposition or direction.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hei, jeg trenger hjelp med datamaskinen min. Noe rart skjer siden jeg endret innstillingene.
dialogue.translation: Hi, I need help with my computer. Something strange is happening since I changed the settings.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hva slags problem har du? Kan du vise meg hva som skjer?
dialogue.translation: What kind of problem do you have? Can you show me what’s happening?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Skjermen blir svart etter noen sekunder, og jeg vet ikke hvorfor. Jeg har prøvd å gjøre det på nytt, men det hjelper ikke.
dialogue.translation: The screen goes black after a few seconds, and I don’t know why. I’ve tried to do it again, but it doesn’t help.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: La meg sjekke en del av innstillingene. Kanskje det er noe annet som påvirker den.
dialogue.translation: Let me check some of the settings. Maybe there’s something else affecting it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Takk! Jeg har prøvd alt, men ingenting virker mot dette problemet.
dialogue.translation: Thanks! I’ve tried everything, but nothing works against this issue.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ikke bekymre deg, vi finner løsningen. La oss jobbe sammen på dette.
dialogue.translation: Don’t worry, we’ll find the solution. Let’s work together on this.

key_phrases.translation: Something strange is happening since I changed the settings.

key_phrases.translation: Can you show me what’s happening?

key_phrases.translation: Let me check some of the settings.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hei, jeg er interessert i å leie en leilighet. Er denne leiligheten ledig?
dialogue.translation: Hi, I'm interested in renting an apartment. Is this apartment available?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, leiligheten er ledig. Prisen er 10 000 kroner per måned, inkludert strøm og vann.
dialogue.translation: Yes, the apartment is available. The price is 10,000 kroner per month, including electricity and water.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Det høres bra ut. Kan jeg få en visning?
dialogue.translation: That sounds good. Can I get a viewing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Selvfølgelig, jeg kan vise deg leiligheten i morgen. Hva slags kontaktinformasjon har du?
dialogue.translation: Of course, I can show you the apartment tomorrow. What contact information do you have?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jeg sender deg min e-postadresse så vi kan avtale tidspunktet.
dialogue.translation: I'll send you my email address so we can arrange the time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Så fint, jeg kontakter deg så snart som mulig.
dialogue.translation: That's great, I'll contact you as soon as possible.

key_phrases.phrase: Prisen er 10 000 kroner per måned, inkludert strøm og vann.
key_phrases.translation: The price is 10,000 kroner per month, including electricity and water.
